name: What is the typical cost to install bathroom wall tile?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to install bathroom wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bathroom wall tile installation varies significantly based on several factors. These include the type and size of tile selected (ceramic, porcelain, natural stone), the complexity of the design, the wall preparation required, and the total area to be tiled. Labor costs also depend on the contractor's experience and location. For an accurate estimate, it's best to get a detailed quote after an on-site assessment, as material and labor can range broadly, typically from $7 to $25 per square foot or more.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile installation costs vary by tile type, design complexity, wall preparation, and labor, typically ranging from $7 to $25+ per square foot. A detailed quote requires an on-site assessment.
